fact: India is the world's largest democracy and home to the Kumbh Mela, the largest human gathering on Earth.
China has the world's longest man-made structure, the Great Wall of China, stretching over 21,000 km.
Russia is the largest country in the world by land area, covering more than one-eighth of Earth’s inhabited land.
Brazil is home to the Amazon Rainforest, which produces more than 20% of the world’s oxygen.
Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world combined.
Japan has the world’s oldest company, founded in 578 AD and still operating today.
Australia is the only country that is also a continent and has over 10,000 beaches.
The U.S. has the highest number of Nobel Prize winners in the world.
Egypt is home to the ancient pyramids, some of which are over 4,500 years old.
France is the birthplace of cinema and has more Nobel laureates in Literature than any other country.
